title: Teaser — Touch This Video
comment: Cues are ANCHORED to script scenes; assemble-film.mjs re-times t0/dur from the derived timeline (anchorScene + anchorOffset; holdToSceneEnd pins a cue to its scene's end). The close composites OVER the live murmuration (ground:chroma); the lockup lands when the narrator says the brand. No button — the handoff down-timeline IS the CTA.
